summary: Harboes Bryggeri A/S produces and markets beverages and malt-based ingredients worldwide. The company offers beers and soda, energy drinks, and malt beverages under the Harboe, NAILED, Caribia, XRAY, Mecklenburger, Bear Beer, Viiking, Darguner, and Hyper Malt brands. It serves supermarket chains and other retail companies, food and beverage manufacturers, and local and international distributors. Harboes Bryggeri A/S was founded in 1883 and is based in Skælskør, Denmark.
